text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Awww...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Both Mejiro Palmer and Ines Fujin fall
short at the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Holy crap... and a half... ☆

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I'm so... tired...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Palmer!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, Ines!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: We gave it our best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We showed everyone just how
gutsy we are!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I think we might've gone too hard,
though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... We were way too stubborn and
way too
reckless!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Brought together by their mutual loss, a
tenuous friendship starts to grow
between them... And
with that, the
Derby comes to a close.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That night...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see. ☆ If I run the way Ines did
today...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: And my bestie slays the getaway...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: What's up, Helios?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nothing. An idea just hit me, and I
was tryna
work it out! ☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
It's a pretty god-tier plan, but it could
also be a
total bust! ♪ But enough of
that. C'mon, let's
keep the party going!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let me just shake up this can of
soda... ☆ Pop the
tab...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Drop in a couple of Menthos candies
and! ★★★
Woohooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Whoooaaa, holy crap! Girl, the soda's
spraying
everywhere! Omigo—pffft!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Their bubbly after-party to celebrate
the Derby
lasts long into the night.
